dedupeText: retro folk pop album gatefold layout 1960s aesthetic duotone solarized sans serif grid layout warm palette folk rock contrast between the structured white background grid on the left and the atmospheric saturated yellow to orange gradient on the right repetition of the glowing white circular motif across both panels to unify the spread interaction between dark silhouetted human figures and a bright central light source creating a solarized effect combine a high saturation duotone background with a rigid multi column typographic grid and silhouetted subjects to evoke mid century folk rock aesthetics

recipe.visualDefinition: A two-panel gatefold layout featuring a high-contrast, warm-toned right panel with a large glowing orb and silhouettes, and a structured left panel with a three-column grid of tracklist information and inset candid photography.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the structured, white-background grid on the left and the atmospheric, saturated yellow-to-orange gradient on the right.
Repetition of the glowing white circular motif across both panels to unify the spread.
Interaction between dark, silhouetted human figures and a bright, central light source creating a solarized effect.
coreInvariants: Warm yellow and orange color gradient
High-contrast black silhouettes against bright backgrounds

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary silhouettes occupy the lower right quadrant; secondary candid photos are framed in the upper left and center-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A large, glowing white sun-like orb in the upper center of the right panel.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bright orb to the display text in the top right, then down to the silhouettes, and finally across to the detailed tracklist on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive yellow gradient space on the right panel provides breathing room for the dense text on the left.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant yellow-to-orange gradient as the background for the right panel and accents on the left.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for silhouettes and body text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the glowing orb and display headers.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellows contrasted with extreme value differences in the black silhouettes and white highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy stroke weights for display titles
High x-height for body text legibility
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold geometric sans for impact paired with a legible condensed sans for information density.
graphicDevices: Rectangular photo frames with thin black borders

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, clean geometric feel of the display text.
Provides the necessary density for the multi-column tracklist.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a two-panel horizontal layout. The right panel features a vibrant yellow-to-orange radial gradient with a large, soft-edged white glowing orb in the upper center. In the bottom right, place two silhouetted male figures with 1960s hairstyles, rendered in deep black with slight orange rim lighting. The left panel has a white background with three rectangular candid photos of the same men at the top, and a large yellow circular glow bleeding from the bottom edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a three-column grid of black text to the bottom half of the left panel. Place a large, two-line uppercase white header in the top right corner of the right panel, right-aligned. Add a small list of red-tinted text in the center-left of the right panel.

verificationChecks: Is the right panel a saturated yellow/orange gradient?
Are there three distinct columns of text on the left?
Is the main header uppercase and extra-bold?
Does the glowing orb have a soft, diffused edge?

adjustableVariables: Number of columns in the tracklist
mustRedesign: Exact track titles and artist names

avoid: Modern digital gradients with too much noise

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the gradient.
Verify the three-column alignment is mathematically precise.
Check that the silhouettes do not have distracting internal details.
Confirm the white orb is the brightest element in the composition.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-saturation duotone background with a rigid multi-column typographic grid and silhouetted subjects to evoke mid-century folk-rock aesthetics.
